prompt: Ute had two free hours at the textile museum in Augsburg. She skipped the lively weaving talk because the main room felt (crowded) than the upstairs gallery. prompt: Florian smiled when he walked into the historic concert room in Weimar. prompt: Tanja compared a yellow backpack and a cloth basket at the market. "Which one stays (dry) in heavy rain?" she asked the seller. The yellow bag also held (much / food) than the small basket. She put it on her back and cycled home.

prompt: Ruben and Raquel arrived early to train for Saturday's badminton match. The upstairs hall was bright, yet they moved (fast) in the cool basement court because they didn't overheat. explanation_ru: Сначала сравниваются два зала (наречия faster, straighter), а затем выделяется один корт из шести (out of all six) — the coolest.

prompt: I tested two cameras before filming our weekly chess club commentary. The sturdy desk lens focused (well) on the wooden pieces than the small travel webcam, so viewers didn't miss a move. However, the small webcam packed (easily) into my bag for away matches. Among all the gear on my desk, that sturdy lens remains (reliable) item I have bought.

prompt: "Should we drive in this thick fog?" Kirsten asked near Stirling. Ross checked the timetable and saw that the regional train travelled (fast) than cars on narrow country lanes. prompt: Strong wind warnings played on the radio as Bruce and Glenda waited at Picton harbour. Catching the midnight boat looked (dangerous) than waiting for the morning flight across the rough sea.
